translations.translatedText: # Friday 24.11.2017 (radio)
A major disaster at a mosque in Egypt. The quality of child protection worries people. Black Friday. The polar night began in Nuorgam.
## A bloody attack on a mosque in Egypt
![Map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9947304)
Open image viewer
The attack was carried out in northern Egypt, near the city of Arish.

Egypt has been hit by a serious attack on a mosque. Egyptian television said in the evening that at least 235 people have died in the attack. The number of dead may be higher. In addition, at least 130 people have been injured.

The attack took place in Sinai, near the city of Arish, on the Mediterranean coast. The attack was carried out while there was Friday prayer in the mosque. Friday is the holy day of Muslims, and that is why there were many people in the mosque.
It is reported that the attackers blew up a bomb in the mosque. In addition, they shot people.
There has been a lot of violence in Sinai recently. Usually soldiers and police are killed in attacks.
## Serious problems were found in child protection
![Doll](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9946333)
Open image viewer
The authorities are worried about child protection in Finland. Photo: Viivi Sihvonen / Yle

In Finland it is hard to get good workers for child protection. Yle News carried out a survey on child protection. The survey found that in many municipalities child protection has got worse, because qualified workers cannot be found, that is, professionals.

According to experts, finding professionals is difficult in very many municipalities. There are so few workers that one worker may have to handle the affairs of 140 children. When there are not enough workers, handling many matters is slow, and many mistakes can happen.
## Christmas shopping began with Black Friday
![Advertisement.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9945096)
Open image viewer
Black Friday is a busy shopping day that has come to Finland from the USA. Photo: Heli Kaski / Yle

Today there was Black Friday in the shops. Black Friday is an important shopping day for shops. Black Friday has come to Finland from the USA. According to traders, people start Christmas shopping when Black Friday arrives.

It used to be said that Christmas shopping starts at the beginning of December. Then Finns get tax refunds from the state. The state pays back tax money to people when too much tax has been taken from their salary. This is a tax refund.
## The polar night began in the north
![Utsjoki church rooms on a cold winter evening.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9946419)
Open image viewer
The polar night is dim but not dark. Photo: Esko Jämsä / AOP

In Nuorgam in Northern Lapland the polar night has begun. The polar night means that the sun does not rise above the horizon. However, the day is not completely dark but dim. Northern lights can be seen in the sky, and snow brings light to nature.

The polar night comes every year to the northern parts of Finland. In winter the Earth tilts so that the sun cannot shine on the northern areas during the day. Tomorrow the polar night begins in Utsjoki.
The polar night is at its strongest just before Christmas. After that the days start to get longer, and the light increases all over Finland.
*Corrected the last sentence to say that the days start to get longer, not shorter.*
